title: Kinda Large
text: Kinda Large. This is SO huge. . . the mug is hard to hold especially at the top. It's leakproof which I liked but the top does dislodge easily so even if it doesn't spill when it tips over use care grabbing for it or you could pop the lid free. Something that screwed into place would be more secure. The paint appears durable and doesn't scratch easily. Capacity is enormous. Your coffee will be cold long before you can finish it. Well, maybe.
